summary.prose: Building s2 means growing the store's unused whole-file replacement into commitFile in two halves (entities, then relationships) on top of in-transaction forms of s1's relationship writers, then reversing the embedding marker so it is set only after a vector is stored, counting and repairing missing vectors, and moving the indexer's refresh, delete and clean-up onto the one commit. The re-embed job becomes a backfill in its own queue lane, run at start and after an index, sized from a measured upsert-versus-add cost; the work ends with a full sweep and a smoke check on the installed daemon.

tasks.title: Split the resolved and pending relationship writers into in-transaction bodies
tasks.summary: upsertResolvedRelations and upsertUnresolvedRelations each get a synchronous *InTxn body that takes the open GraphStore and returns its counts; the existing async functions call it inside their own withWriteTxn, so their behaviour (s1's keep-pending / count-unwritable rule) is unchanged.
acceptanceChecks: the existing relations test files pass unchanged
both in-transaction bodies can be called inside a caller's withWriteTxn and their writes roll back with it

tasks.title: Add the FileCommit, FileCommitResult and RelationWrite types
tasks.summary: Export the sc2 types from the store layer and the mapping of RelationWrite (stored / pending target, evidence accepted and ignored) onto the existing Relation shape the writers take.
acceptanceChecks: the types match the HLD sc2 sketch field for field
a RelationWrite with a stored target maps to a resolved Relation and one with a pending target to an unresolved Relation with the same meta

tasks.title: Grow reindexFile into commitFile: the entity half
tasks.summary: One withWriteTxn: read the file's existing entities through entityByFile, upsert the parsed entities (module stubs ensure-exists), detach entities no longer parsed, advance the generation and drop the file from uncommittedFiles; contentHash null removes the file's entities. reindexFile becomes a thin wrapper. Returns FileCommitResult.
acceptanceChecks: the file's previous entities are found through entityByFile, not a scan of the entity table
a commit that throws part-way leaves every row of the file as before, read after a reopen
contentHash null removes the file's entities in one transaction
the generation advances and the file leaves uncommittedFiles in the same transaction
reindex-file-lmdb tests still pass through the wrapper

tasks.title: commitFile: the relationship half
tasks.summary: Inside commitFile's transaction: remove the outgoing edges of every previous entity of the file and the file's pending rows, write commit.relations through t1's in-transaction bodies, and return each incoming relationship of a removed entity whose holder survives to pending awaiting the removed id.
acceptanceChecks: a refresh replaces the file's outgoing relationships and pending rows in the same transaction as its entities
incoming relationships of surviving entities are left in place
contentHash null removes the file's entities, relationships and pending rows together and returns incoming relationships of other files to pending (ac4)
a relationship whose target is not stored becomes a pending row awaiting the id (s1's rule, unchanged)

tasks.title: Set the embedding marker only after the vector is stored
tasks.summary: Every writer stores entity rows with an empty marker; after the commit the vectors are written (plain add for an entity first allocated in this commit, upsert otherwise; deletes for removed entities) and a second transaction sets the written entities' markers to the active backend's model. upsertEntities and updateEmbedding get the same order; embedEntities no longer sets the marker on the entity.
acceptanceChecks: a failed vector write leaves the changed entities' markers empty
a successful write sets each marker to the active backend's model name
updateEmbedding writes the vector before the marker
a first-allocated entity uses the plain add, a changed one the upsert
FileCommitResult.vectorsOutstanding reports the entities whose vector was not written

tasks.title: Count unembedded entities
tasks.summary: IndexState.unembedded is adjusted in the commit transaction and the marker transaction for entities the embed step selects (non-empty body), and recounted from the entity table by reconcileIndexStateInTxn on open.
acceptanceChecks: after a commit whose vector write failed, unembedded equals the number of selected entities without a vector and the repository is not complete
empty-body entities (endpoints, module stubs) are never counted
the recount on open corrects a wrong stored count

tasks.title: Compare entity ids with the vector table at start
tasks.summary: On the indexing worker at start, before any backfill is queued: delete vectors whose entity is not stored, and clear the marker (and count unembedded) of an entity whose marker is set but whose vector is missing.
acceptanceChecks: an orphan vector is deleted before a plain add for the same id can run
an entity with a set marker and no vector has its marker cleared and is counted unembedded

tasks.title: Move the indexer's refresh, delete and clean-up removal onto commitFile
tasks.summary: IndexerService.indexFile reads, parses, resolves and embeds, then calls commitFile once (no delete first); the delete branch of fileEvent and removeStoredFile call commitFile with contentHash null; a file event whose parse, embed or commit fails records the file in uncommittedFiles.
acceptanceChecks: a file event whose embed throws leaves the previous rows and records the file as uncommitted (ac1)

an integration test that holds the embed step on a promise and reads the file's entities and outgoing relationships through the store in the meantime gets the complete old set, and after the commit the complete new set (ac2)
no deleteEntitiesForFile / deleteUnresolvedForFile / upsertEntities / upsertRelations call remains on the refresh path

tasks.title: Give the backfill its own queue lane
tasks.summary: A third IndexQueue lane takes the reembed jobs, running beside the index lane so file, full and reconcile jobs are never queued behind it; the status board publishes it with the other two lanes.
acceptanceChecks: a reembed job never delays a file job queued after it
the lane's depth and processing state are published
depthForRepo still counts a queued reembed for its repository

tasks.title: Extend reembed into the backfill and queue it
tasks.summary: reembed selects with the embed step's own selection (not force), reads through the by-repository index (listUnembeddedEntities), writes vector then marker, names the active backend's model, and sets embeddingAvailable false on an outage / true on success; it is queued for every registered repository at start (after t6) and after every full index and clean-up.
acceptanceChecks: after a commit whose vector write failed, the backfill at start writes the vectors, sets the markers and the repository reads complete (ac3)
an unreachable backend sets embeddingAvailable false without failing the job
empty-body entities are never selected

tasks.title: Measure the vector upsert against the plain add on this repository
tasks.summary: Two-point smoke: time writeEntityEmbeddings vs addEntityEmbeddings on this repository's vector table at a refresh-sized and a backfill-sized batch, record both in the Story's test record, and set the backfill's batch size from them.
acceptanceChecks: both timings at both sizes are recorded as a smoke result in the test record
the backfill batch size is set from the measurement and stated with it

tests.name: upsert vs add on this repository's vector table (two-point)

tasks.title: Ship and smoke on the installed daemon
tasks.summary: Full sweep once, update the installed daemon, and on this repository check a refresh under load, a delete, and the backfill at start (unembedded goes to zero and the repository reads complete).
acceptanceChecks: full sweep shows no failure caused by this Story

on the installed daemon: while one indexed file of this repository is edited repeatedly, every poll of search.by_file for it returns the file's entities (recorded), a deleted file's rows are gone in one step, and unembedded reaches zero after the backfill at start with the repository reading complete

tests.name: installed daemon: refresh under polling, delete, backfill at start
